parsed.summary: Tracing every sheet against the specification shows the build matches the intended design: the power mux (U3) takes +12V on IN1 and +5V on IN2 with OUT=VBUS feeding the AP63203 buck (U10, EN on VBUS, FB on +3V3, L=3.9µH, bootstrap 100nF), the TPS1H200 heater switch (U4) is driven from the GPIO1 net with CL/GND/EP grounded and FAULT broken out to a test point only, the three MAX31855 thermocouple channels share SCK/SO (GPIO5/GPIO10) with independent CS on GPIO4/6/7 and 1µF VCC decoupling, the USB-C CC pins use 5.1k pulldowns with D+/D- correctly routed to GPIO19/18, and the fan-tach lines carry TVS protection. Reference designators are permuted relative to the spec (e.g. ESP32=U2, mux=U3, buck=U10) and nets use auto-generated NET00xx names, but these are naming/ordering differences, not functional deviations; the two superseded ICs (LM73100, MPM3606) are correctly absent. No shorted, bridged, mis-valued, or mis-typed connection was found.
